Name: ExtendedLootTables
Author: EchoHarbor
Description:
[b]ExtendedLootTables[/b] is a [b]content framework mod[/b] for Stardew Valley designed for mod authors who want to add [b]custom monster drops[/b] to the game without writing their own SMAPI code.
Instead of replacing the game’s existing loot logic, ExtendedLootTables uses [b]Harmony patching[/b] to inject new drop rules directly into the monster loot system. This ensures that:
[list]
[*][b]Vanilla drops remain intact[/b] — your changes simply add to them.
[*]Custom items through Json Assets SHOULD integrate naturally for drops.
[*]Drop logic runs automatically whenever a monster dies, using your configured drop chances.
[/list]As a content creator, all you need to do is:
[list=1]
[*]Create or reference a custom item (usually via [b]Json Assets[/b]).

[*]Define which monster(s) can drop it and the probability of the drop in a simple JSON file.

[*]Place that [code]lootdrops.json[/code] alongside your mod’s [code]manifest.json[/code] — ExtendedLootTables will automatically detect and load it. (I hope)

[/list]

Downloads.Description: ExtendedLootTables is a lightweight framework for Stardew Valley that lets mod authors easily add custom monster loot without replacing vanilla drops.
